english.title: Company / other person fail to state in correspondence that receiver / manager appointed
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[a company in respect of which, when a receiver of the property had been appointed,]_
(B)_[a company in respect of which, when a manager of the property had been appointed,]_
(C)_[an officer of **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..) who knowingly and wilfully authorised the default of that company in that]_
(D)_[an officer of **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..) who knowingly and wilfully permitted the default of that company in that]_
(E)_[a liquidator of **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..) who knowingly and wilfully authorised the default of that company in that]_
(F)_[a liquidator of **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..) who knowingly and wilfully permitted the default of that company in that]_
(G)_[a receiver of the property of **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..) who knowingly and wilfully authorised the default of that company in that]_
(H)_[a receiver of the property of **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..) who knowingly and wilfully permitted the default of that company in that]_
(I)_[a manager of the property of **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..) who knowingly and wilfully authorised the default of that company in that]_
(J)_[a manager of the property of **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..) who knowingly and wilfully permitted the default of that company in that]_

not every invoice, order for goods or services, business letter or order form issued by or on behalf of the company or the receiver or manager or the liquidator of the company and not all of

(K)_[your]_
(L)_[its]_

websites contained a statement that a

(M)_[receiver]_
(N)_[manager]_

had been appointed
english.legislation: Contrary to section 39 of, and Schedule 10 to, the Insolvency Act 1986.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Section 431 of the Insolvency Act 1986 provides that notwithstanding anything in section 127(1) of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980, an information relating to such an offence which is triable by a magistrates' court in England and Wales may be so tried if it is laid at any time within 3 years after the commission of the offence and within 12 months after the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the Director of Public Prosecutions or the Secretary of State (as the case may be) to justify the proceedings comes to his knowledge. Summary proceedings in Scotland for such an offence shall not be commenced after the expiration of 3 years from the commission of the offence.
